text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Right before the start of the JBC Sprint, Haru Urara is filled with a strong desire to win and even gets nervous.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She knows that she needs to gain more fans and place well in the rankings.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that in mind, full of motivation and her spirits high, she heads toward the race.
